evals.name: invoice-intake-batch
evals.prompt: Set up k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/ by copying plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/briefs/invoice-intake.yaml to brief.yaml, plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/plans/invoice-intake.yaml to stage-plan.yaml, every file under plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/records/invoice-intake/ into decisions/, and plugins/forjate/evals/fixtures/gates/invoice-intake.yaml to gates.yaml (create the directories; do not copy anything else). Write packs.yaml there activating the pack at context-packs/examples/regulated-corp (name regulated-corp) and set spec.context_packs to [regulated-corp] in the brief. Then, as the app-scaffold builder of the Forjate use-case builder, generate the walking skeleton of this use case under k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/app/ from its decision records (an entry point for every workload of every stage in scope, one typed tool contract per AI-engineering tool line, every store, model route and external system wired to its double, a deterministic model double for CI next to the real client, the seed and the verify script that proves the route, a connection diagram, contract tests that pass without a cluster, a Dockerfile, and .github/workflows/ for the app repo; no business logic beyond what the verify script needs and no domain unit tests: the business rules are seams for the backlog), and write k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/.builder/scaffold.yaml following plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/schemas/scaffold.schema.json. Check it with plugins/forjate/scripts/builder/scaffold-check.py and run the app's tests.
evals.expected_output: A walking skeleton: seed, batch, verify, the ERP and mailbox stubs at Crawl and entry points for cron-job, posting-worker and review-api at Walk; seven typed tool contracts (post_invoice idempotent and requiring the approval token, lookup_po and the mailbox reads read-only) as seams marked SEAM; a replay double reading the seed's labels; a verify script printing connected per seam, the assertions the skeleton makes true, PENDING for the rest, reading VERIFY_STRICT and printing KPI straight_through_rate; a connection diagram; contract tests only; workflows calling the templates @v1 with the app-image-updated dispatch; scaffold.yaml with spec.skeleton citing the regulated-corp TOOLS guideline; backlog.py derives the tickets.

assertions.text: app/pyproject.toml written
Dockerfile written
scaffold.yaml validates
scaffold-check: tool signatures match the record, templates @v1, no hand-rolled build
scaffold.yaml declares the walking skeleton and its seams

assertions.expr: set(['posting-worker', 'review-api']) <= {w.get('name') for w in spec.get('workloads', []) if w.get('stage') == 'walk'}
assertions.text: the Walk workloads of the architecture record (posting-worker, review-api) have entry points at stage walk
verify proves each seam connected
verify reads the strict switch the Walk overlay sets
seams are marked where the business rule goes
backlog.py derives a backlog from the scaffold (at least three tickets)

assertions.cmd: L=$(find k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/app/src -name '*.py' -print0 | xargs -0 cat | wc -l) && T=$(grep -rho 'def test_' k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/app/tests | wc -l) && echo "src=$L tests=$T" && test $L -le 2000 && test $T -le 40
assertions.text: a skeleton, not the business: at most 2000 lines under app/src and 40 test functions (#28 wrote 3,550 lines and 100-220 tests)
build, scan and push through the shared template @v1
PR validation through the shared template
image write-back dispatch to the IaC repo
no hand-rolled build or push step (comments ignored)
Dockerfile runs as a non-root user
base image pinned, never latest
model mode selectable (deterministic double for CI)
log lines carry the data class

assertions.cmd: cd k8s/overlays/usecases/invoice-intake/app && PYG=$(for p in python3.12 python3.11 python3; do $p -c 'import sys' >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo $p && break; done) && $PYG -m venv .venv-grade && .venv-grade/bin/pip -q install -e '.[test]' 2>&1 | tail -3 && .venv-grade/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider tests
assertions.text: the app's tests pass in a fresh virtualenv
the image builds
post_invoice tool exists
lookup_po tool exists
fetch_invoice_attachment tool exists
verify prints the KPI line (straight_through_rate)
the approval token is enforced in code
a test proves post_invoice refuses without the token
a replay double reads the seed's labels

assertions.expr: any(w.get('kind') == 'job' and w.get('phase') == 'verify' for w in spec.get('workloads', [])) and any(w.get('phase') == 'seed' for w in spec.get('workloads', []))
assertions.text: scaffold.yaml declares the seed and verify Jobs

assertions.expr: any('stub' in w.get('name', '') for w in spec.get('workloads', []))
assertions.text: the ERP stub is a workload
the pack's tool-development guideline is cited

assertions.expr: any('approval' in f for t in spec.get('tools', []) if t.get('name') == 'post_invoice' for f in t.get('flags', []))
assertions.text: scaffold.yaml carries post_invoice's approval flag
scaffold.yaml carries the architecture record's runtime
